items.verbatim: WEDC Grant under the International Market Access Grant program, awarded 2025-04-03 to a recipient in City of Milwaukee, Milwaukee County. Industry: Manufacturing (NAICS 336212). Award amount: $30,000. Planned project cost: $39,000. Deliverables: Business Plan/Feasibility Study.

items.summary: Wisconsin WEDCのInternational Market Access Grantにより、Milwaukee市のVector Technologies LTD.(NAICS 336212、トラック車体・トレーラー製造)に$25,000が交付された。計画総事業費は$32,500で、海外市場開拓支援が目的。
